description: Generate niche-tailored domain name ideas (personal email, newsletter, homelab, portfolio, 5-letter brandable, SaaS/AI, domain hacks, e-commerce, etc.) and verify live DNS availability via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1. availableOnly.description: When true (default), only return domains confirmed available via live DNS check.

keyword.description: Primary keyword, brand seed, or first name.

mode.description: Specialized domain naming algorithm to run.

secondaryKeyword.description: Optional second word, craft/role, or last name (used in personal-email, portfolio, and combiner modes).
